name: @aethelred/wallet-integration
description: End-to-end composition layer for the Aethelred moat stack. Ships (a) the AgentBudget-as-PaymentGate + reputation-as-SponsorPolicy adapters that let every upstream package consume every downstream package without bespoke glue, and (b) the reference end-to-end demo that exercises every moat layer (custody -> invoice -> intent -> reputation -> budget -> x402 -> paymaster -> audit -> notarization) in a single executable. Tier-1 proof-of-moat artifact.
